title: ArXiv: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs under Long-Tail Divergent Knowledge
description: Abstract: Factual question answering (QA) typically assumes a single canonical answer, obscuring whether large language models (LLMs) retain divergent accounts of long-tail facts. To address this gap, we introd...

en.title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs
en.hook: Discover how LLMs handle divergent accounts of long-tail facts beyond single canonical answers.
key_takeaways: Analyze limitations of single canonical answers in factual QA
Investigate retention of divergent accounts for long-tail facts
Probe epistemic myopia phenomena in large language models

调查大模型是否保留长尾事实的分散记录
探测大模型的认知近视现象
